title: Carbon Forge Heat Treatment Studio
description: The user operates a virtual heat treatment forge where a carbon fibre component is suspended above a pot of glowing coals. Through a multi-step post-processing pipeline, the user adjusts bloom intensity to simulate coal heat radiation, applies chromatic aberration to represent heat shimmer, tunes a custom color grading LUT for thermal visualization, and controls an emissive vignette that pulses with forge intensity. Each parameter must stay within validated ranges to achieve a successful heat treatment result.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load CarbonFibre.glb and position it centered at y=1.5, slowly rotating on its Y-axis. Load PotOfCoals.glb and place it below at y=0 as the heat source. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 2, 5) looking at origin. Add a warm PointLight (orange, intensity 3) inside the pot area and a dim AmbientLight (0.15). Build a post-processing pipeline with these passes: (1) RenderPass, (2) UnrealBloomPass for coal glow, (3) ShaderPass for chromatic aberration with a custom shader splitting RGB channels, (4) ShaderPass for color grading that shifts colors toward a thermal palette (blue-cold to red-hot), (5) ShaderPass for animated vignette. Create an HTML overlay panel with these validated controls: Bloom Threshold slider (0.0-1.0, default 0.6), Bloom Strength slider (0.0-3.0, default 1.5), Bloom Radius slider (0.0-1.0, default 0.4), Chromatic Aberration Offset slider (0.0-0.02, default 0.005), Thermal Intensity slider (0.0-1.0, default 0.3) controlling the color grading mix, Vignette Darkness slider (0.0-2.0, default 1.0), and a Forge Pulse Speed slider (0.1-5.0, default 1.0) that animates the vignette and bloom strength sinusoidally. Validate all inputs: clamp to min/max, reject NaN. The coal pot should have an emissive material override tinted orange-red whose intensity responds to Thermal Intensity. The carbon fibre piece should gain a subtle emissive tint as Thermal Intensity increases, simulating heat absorption. Add a readout panel showing current parameter values and a status label that reads 'Forging...' when Thermal Intensity > 0.7 and Bloom Strength > 2.0 simultaneously, otherwise 'Idle'. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction. Animate everything in a requestAnimationFrame loop updating uniforms each frame.
